messages:
lina: heads-up - post rotation some customers reported SSO succeed then immediate sign-out. also saw a couple missing SCIM role events in audit. anyone oncall?

sam: saw session-create followed by immediate clear in SP logs. assertion validation ok; server-side decrypt returned rpc DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.

devon: infra ran KMS rekey at ~02:05 UTC. KMS p95 spiked ~3s for a short window. likely overlap.

lina: current SCIM flow ack's PATCH even on decrypt timeout to avoid retries. that causes silent role loss and no audit entry. not acceptable for compliance.

sam: quick mitigation: return 409 on decrypt timeout (idp will retry), and add an audit preflight "role-change-attempt" entry so attempted changes are recorded even if final write fails.

devon: I'll add a cached-decrypt fallback (TTL 24h) and instrument metric scim_kms_timeouts. also will schedule rekeys during low-traffic windows and add jitter.

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-031-09 created: "KMS rekey overlapped active decrypts -> session invalidation & SCIM role write loss"

lina: action owners: devon (cache fallback + infra schedule), sam (repro & canary), lina (audit preflight + postmortem). please post links to PRs in the incident ticket.

devon: will do. also adding vuln-triage note: swallowing KMS errors = silent-data-loss anti-pattern; postmortem should recommend platform library for explicit retries or fail-fast to caller.
